comment: Mock LLM response for POI Agent - points of interest

points_of_interest.name: Belém Tower
points_of_interest.description: Iconic 16th-century fortress on the Tagus River, a UNESCO World Heritage Site and symbol of Portugal's Age of Discovery.

points_of_interest.name: Jerónimos Monastery
points_of_interest.description: Stunning Manueline architecture, UNESCO site, and final resting place of Vasco da Gama.

points_of_interest.name: Time Out Market
points_of_interest.description: Gourmet food hall showcasing Portugal's best chefs in a vibrant marketplace setting.

points_of_interest.name: Alfama District
points_of_interest.description: Lisbon's oldest neighborhood with narrow streets, Fado music venues, and medieval charm.

points_of_interest.name: São Jorge Castle
points_of_interest.description: Medieval Moorish castle offering panoramic views of Lisbon and interactive history exhibits.
